steps.player: Vanescula. You're still in your vampyre form?

steps.npc: Yes, nice of you to point that out. Thanks to my injuries, shapeshifting is no longer possible for me. I'm likely stuck in this disgusting form forever now. Lowerniel would probably have been thrilled.

steps.player: We humans have a saying, Vanescula: If you play with fire, you're going to get burnt.

steps.npc: I burnt myself for a better future, for my people, and for yours.

steps.player: After all that's happened, do you really still believe that?

steps.npc: You may not like what I did, but whether you accept it or not, Lowerniel was only defeated thanks to me.
I was the one that turned Safalaan, giving him the strength to injure him. I was the one that gave you the information needed to make a weapon capable of killing him.
You're free to keep telling yourself that, but deep down, I think you know the truth. Now, while this has been a thrilling chat, I've tired of conversing with you. Be on your way.
